title: Find the names of players born before 1986 who have above-average overall r
question: Find the names of players born before 1986 who have above-average overall rating among players born before 1986 and are not among those with the maximum potential score. Order by their overall rating in descending order and return the top 5.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE SUBSTR(p.XCL_125, 1, 4) < '1986'
  AND pa.XCL_132 > (
    SELECT AVG(pa2.XCL_132)
    FROM Player p2
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON p2.XCL_122 = pa2.XCL_130
    WHERE SUBSTR(p2.XCL_125, 1, 4) < '1986'
  )
  AND p.XCL_122 NOT IN (
    SELECT pa3.XCL_130
    FROM Player_Attributes pa3
    WHERE pa3.XCL_133 = (SELECT MAX(XCL_133) FROM Player_Attributes)
  )
ORDER BY pa.XCL_132 DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE SUBSTR(p.XCL_125, 1, 4) < '1986'
  AND pa.XCL_132 > (
    SELECT AVG(pa2.XCL_132)
    FROM Player p2
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON p2.XCL_122 = pa2.XCL_130
    WHERE SUBSTR(p2.XCL_125, 1, 4) < '1986'
  )
  AND p.XCL_122 NOT IN (
    SELECT pa3.XCL_130
    FROM Player_Attributes pa3
    WHERE pa3.XCL_133 = (SELECT MAX(XCL_133) FROM Player_Attributes)
  )
ORDER BY pa.XCL_132 DESC
LIMIT 5
